Figure 8 (map). One backward step on the first road of the route from 원당리 (315 m), 18:00 KST, 25 March 2025. Arriving at the
far end by 18:22:42 still reaches a shelter; the drive takes 29 s; fire reaches the start of the road at 18:15:27. The leave-by time
is the earlier limit, 18:15:21, set by the fire; it equals the village's leave-by time from the field.
